features.trigger: Toggling a machine-scope Microsoft Edge policy registered by NewEdge before callback binding; excludes later-added legacy Edge E011/E012.
features.implementationDecision: Preserve as explicit opt-in setting; do not silently copy this side effect.
features.aggregateStateScope: At callback time, evaluate all enabled setting records whose registered target is HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge.
features.normalization: Expose a single explicit shared Edge DNS mode control and bind a reviewed source preset choice to it; capture original value. Do not claim exact aggregate callback behavior unless implemented and tested.

features.trigger: Deleting a registry value from a policy path
features.effect: Delete that key and successive empty policy ancestors only while they contain no values or subkeys.
features.implementationDecision: If implemented, delete only empty keys created and owned by this app transaction.
features.normalization: Deliberately normalize to exact app-owned recovery. Broad factory-reset deletion is not required for restoring prior state; record this as a scope decision.
features.implementation: Restore captured values and prune only unchanged empty keys created by the operation.

features.trigger: Factory reset of selected setting collection
